name: Toast + MORE
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: TFT11
description: Toast + more adds a delicious selection of toast-themed foods to Minecraft including: Toast, Jam, Jam on Toast, Marmalade, and Marmalade on Toast. Perfect for players wanting to add a few vanilla-style foods to their minecraft worlds!
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
